methodology: Unmodified shipped lab.html, no assembly. Fresh context per viewport; DPR 1; three-second requestAnimationFrame sample. Headless Chromium is a repeatable local comparison, not school-device GPU certification.

measurements.uiText:
Entelloq

Biology Entelloq · Dissection Lab

Choose your specimen

Dissect with your hands or the mouse — both do everything. Hand tracking runs entirely on your device; nothing is recorded.

SPECIMEN
Frog

The classic teaching dissection. Pin it out, open the body wall, and find every organ system in one cavity.

SPECIMEN
Mammalian heart

Trace the circulation. Open the left ventricle, meet the chordae tendineae, and test the valves.

SPECIMEN
Earthworm

The classic annelid. Pin it dorsal-up, open the coelom just off the midline to spare the dorsal vessel, and trace the gut.

SPECIMEN
Bony fish

Open the left flank of a teleost: lift the operculum, count the four gill arches, and find the pearly swim bladder.

SPECIMEN
Cockroach

The classic insect dissection: lift the wings, cut the terga, and find the fat body, gizzard and Malpighian tubules.

STEP 1 / 8
Pin the frog out by its four limbs so the body wall comes under tension.
